tonight.headline: Likely is the swing piece, and a fallback costs Jacobs
body: Bad news first: Isaiah Likely did not practise Friday (groin), you carry no other tight end, and nothing newer appeared by Saturday morning. He has no game status and Harbaugh calls it 'minor', so he starts. Friday's brief said nothing could cover him. That was incomplete: free-agent tight ends still play after 13:55, including Mike Gesicki on Monday night, but the only seats you could open then are Jacobs' and Golden's. The plan is in the lineup check.
Tuten went limited Friday and has no game status, so he starts and Rice stays benched. Taylor's 6.7 is final. The lineup as set is the projection lineup. ESPN has you at 118.1 to 111.9 and 53%.

contingencies.if: Inactive at Sun 13:55 CDMX (JAX @ NYG, 15:25). DNP Friday (groin), no game status, no Saturday update
contingencies.then: Rice and Odunze lock at 12:00 and Marks is locked, so the only unlocked drops are Jacobs and Golden. Free-agent tight ends still play later, including Mike Gesicki (CIN, Monday). My call is to take the zero rather than cut Jacobs, who has a 'realistic chance' for Week 12. If you would rather chase this week, Gesicki for Jacobs is the move. Never Golden
